license_required.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

exams.name: Board examination in optics, optometry, anatomy and physiology of the eye
exams.notes: Includes theoretic, practical and physiological optics, theoretic and practical optometry, anatomy and physiology of the eye, and demonstration of ability to use ophthalmoscope, retinoscope, perimeter and other instruments
exams.quote: shall have passed an examination conducted by the board in theoretic, practical and physiological optics, in theoretic and practical optometry and in the anatomy and physiology of the eye

exams.name: Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agents Examination (Section 68C)
exams.notes: Required for certification to use and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents; may include NBEO examination portions
exams.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized in section 66C

required.quote: As a condition of license renewal, an optometrist licensed under this section shall submit to the board of registration in optometry evidence attesting to the completion of 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

hours_per_period.quote: completion of 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

topical_requirements.quote: 3 hours of continuing education specific to glaucoma

available.quote: Any person who shall present to the board a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in optometry in any other state, where the requirements for registration are in the opinion of the board equivalent to those of this commonwealth, may be registered and given a certificate of registration in this commonwealth without a written examination

requirements.value: Applicant must present a certified copy of out-of-state registration; the other state's requirements must be equivalent; that state must accord a like privilege to MA holders; applicant must not have previously failed the MA examination; must have been engaged in reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding application; and must intend to reside and practice optometry in MA.
requirements.quote: provided, that such state accords a like privilege to holders of certificates of registration issued in this commonwealth, and that the applicant has not previously failed to pass the examination required in this commonwealth, and that he has been engaged in the reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding his application, and that he intends to reside and practice optometry in this commonwealth

regulatory_model.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this section, shall practice optometry until he shall have passed an examination conducted by the board

credential_type.quote: shall have been registered and shall have received a certificate of registration

is_mandatory.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice optometry, practices optometry, or holds himself out as a practitioner of, or as being able to practice, optometry

title_protection.quote: holds himself out as a practitioner of, or as being able to practice, optometry

scope_protection.quote: Whoever, not being lawfully authorized to practice optometry, practices optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in making application or taking an examination for registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may refuse to grant a certificate of registration to any applicant found guilty of fraud in making application or taking an examination for registration.
The board may revoke or suspend any certificate of registration for unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in practice or in advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in practice or in advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual drunkenness for six months immediately before the charges are made
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for habitual drunkenness for six months immediately before the charges are made

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule or regulation made under section 67
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or for violation of any rule or regulation made under section sixty-seven

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross misconduct in the practice of the profession or practicing with gross incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of deceit, malpractice, gross misconduct in the practice of his profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while ability to practice was impaired by alcohol or drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in the practice of his profession while the ability to practice was impaired by alcohol or drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly permitting, aiding or abetting an unauthorized person in performing activities requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly permitted, aided or abetted an unauthorized person in performing activities requiring a license, certificate, registration or authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license issued by another jurisdiction revoked, suspended, cancelled, or otherwise acted against
disciplinary_grounds.quote: had a license, certificate, registration or authority issued by another state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or a foreign state or nation with authority to issue such a license, certificate, registration or authority revoked, cancelled, suspended, not renewed or otherwise acted against

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids and the utilization of corrective procedures to preserve, restore or improve vision

value: prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses
methods_authorized.quote: diagnosis, prevention, correction, management or treatment of optical deficiencies, optical deformities, visual anomalies, muscular anomalies, ocular diseases and ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue, including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes, by utilization of pharmaceutical agents, by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids

drug_authority.value: Topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including schedules III, IV, V and VI; all necessary eye-related medications including oral anti-infective medications; but not agents for systemic diseases, not injectable agents, and not opioids
drug_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B that are used in the practice of optometry, including those placed in schedules III, IV, V and VI pursuant to section 2 of said chapter 94C

surgery_prohibited.quote: a registered optometrist shall not use or prescribe: (A) therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of systemic diseases; (B) invasive surgical procedures

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes

minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: including removal of superficial foreign bodies and misaligned eyelashes

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: for the purpose of diagnosing, preventing, correcting, managing or treating glaucoma and other ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: cardiopulmonary resuscitation, including treatment of anaphylaxis: four hours

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: by the prescription, adaptation and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, prosthetic devices and other optical aids

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: a registered optometrist shall not use or prescribe: (A) therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of systemic diseases; (B) invasive surgical procedures; (C) pharmaceutical agents administered by subdermal injection, intramuscular injection, intravenous injection, subcutaneous injection, intraocular injection or retrobulbar injection; or (D) an opioid substance or drug product.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as defined in section 66B that are used in the practice of optometry

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: A registered optometrist who is qualified by an examination for practice under section 68, certified under section 68C and registered to issue written prescriptions pursuant to subsection (h) of section 7 of chapter 94C may

dea_registration_required.quote: be registered pursuant to subsection (h) of section 7 of said chapter 94C to use or prescribe pharmaceutical agents for the purpose of diagnosing or treating glaucoma and other ocular abnormalities of the human eye and adjacent tissue

specialty_certification_types.quote: The board of registration in optometry shall administer an examination to permit the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents as authorized in section 66C

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: furnish to the board of registration in optometry evidence of the satisfactory completion of 40 hours of didactic education and 20 hours of supervised clinical education relating to the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents under section 66C

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: 20 hours of supervised clinical education relating to the use and prescription of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents under section 66C

referral_to_physician_required.quote: the optometrist shall refer the patient to a licensed physician or other qualified health care practitioner

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: If an optometrist diagnoses a patient with congenital glaucoma or if, during the course of examining, managing or treating a patient with glaucoma, the optometrist determines that surgical treatment is indicated, the optometrist shall refer the patient to a qualified health care provider for treatment.

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: The department shall establish a voluntary program for monitoring the rehabilitation of licensed health care professionals who seek support for their mental health or substance use or who are referred to the program by a licensing board.
